meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Remove AI-generated code smells (slop) from branch changes or an explicit file list. Locks behavior with regression tests FIRST, then runs categorized cleanup via parallel `deep` agents in batches of 5, then verifies with quality gates. Covers 10 slop categories including performance equivalences, excessive complexity (object annotations, if/elif variant chains), and oversized modules (250+ pure LOC with mandatory modular refactoring). MUST USE when the user asks to "remove slop", "clean AI code", "deslop", "clean up AI-generated code", "remove AI slop", or wants to clean up AI-generated patterns from recent changes. Triggers - "remove ai slops", "clean ai code", "deslop", "cleanup AI generated", "remove AI slop", "clean up AI-generated code", "strip slop", "ai-slop cleanup".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测并清理AI生成的代码坏味道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理AI助手生成的冗余或低效代码
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect and clean AI-generated code smells
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean up redundant or inefficient code from AI assistants

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先给改动写回归测试锁定行为，再按 10 类清理 AI 代码问题（多余注释、过度复杂、超大模块等），超过 250 行的源文件会拆成小模块，最后跑质量检查，不过就回退或直接改。
howto.when: 当你说“remove slop”“clean AI code”等触发词，或要求清理最近改动/指定文件里的 AI 生成痕迹时触发。

say.text: 把这个分支相对 main 的改动清一遍 AI slop，先加回归测试。
say.note: 它会按“先测后清”的流程执行。

say.text: 清理这几个文件里的过度复杂和死代码：src/foo.py、src/bar.py。
say.note: 它会把这两个文件列入清理范围。

say.text: 把超过 250 行的源文件拆成合适模块，别用 utils.py。
say.note: 它先给拆分方案再动手。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude first adds regression tests to lock behavior, then cleans 10 categories of AI code smells (redundant comments, over-complexity, oversized modules), splits files over 250 lines into modules, then runs quality gates; failures trigger revert or direct edit.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'remove slop', 'clean AI code' or similar trigger phrases, or ask to clean AI-generated patterns from recent changes or an explicit file list.

say_en.text: Clean the AI slop in this branch vs main; add regression tests first.
Clean over-complexity and dead code in src/foo.py and src/bar.py.
say_en.note: Those files are added to scope.

say_en.text: Split source files over 250 lines into proper modules; avoid utils.py.
say_en.note: It proposes a split plan before editing.
